items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Manuel Manetta on piano. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, we did. Did you? Yeah. You see, on that line up, yeah, well, on this line up, we got three different men on that line up. Yeah. On this line up, we have this boy Paggio on tenor. Paul Barnes on alto, on this tape, on this one, yeah. Shots on the second trumpet. Celestane on first one.

And then John Marrero and Simon Marrero. Yeah. And Manuel Manetta on piano. On piano. Let's play this black rag, and then if you have anything else you can add to it, we can... This is the one called black rag. Originally it was trombone. Yeah. This is made in famous? This one here. Who wrote this, do you remember? Yeah, well, uh... Is this one of your original compositions there for the band? No, the real name is the band. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
